title: A-site composition engineering in high-entropy AFeO3 perovskite SOFC cathodes and unraveling oxygen reduction mechanisms
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00340G, Paper
Zepeng Li, Yanfeng Ge, Weilin Jia, Mingrun Du, Xueting Yi, Yu Ma, Jingya Wang, Bo Liu, Yuan Li, Huanbin Li
High-entropy perovskite cathodes with tailored A-site compositions are engineered for SOFC. Low-valence and Bi3+ elements incorporation boost oxygen vacancy formation and iron valence modulation. DRT analysis deciphers oxygen transport mechanisms.
